peers.name: emil-design-eng
peers.description: Emil Kowalski's design-engineering philosophy for UI polish, component design, animation decisions, and the invisible details that make software feel great. Use when building or reviewing a UI component's interactions and polish (press and hover states, popover origin, tooltip timing, transitions vs keyframes, clip-path techniques, drag details) and no narrower skill fits.

peers.name: apple-design
peers.description: Apple's approach to interface design and fluid, physical motion, translated for the web. Use when building or reviewing gesture-driven UI, spring animations, drag/swipe/sheet interactions, momentum and interruptible transitions, translucent materials and depth, typography (optical sizing, tracking, leading), reduced-motion, or the design foundations (feedback, spatial consistency, restraint) behind Apple-style interfaces.

peers.name: animation-vocabulary
peers.description: Reverse-lookup glossary that turns a vague description of a web animation or motion effect into its exact term ("the bouncy thing when a popover opens" → Pop in; "the iOS rubber-band scroll" → Rubber-banding). Use when the user asks "what's it called when…", or describes a motion effect without knowing its name and wants the right word to prompt an AI or designer with. For naming an effect, not designing or building one.

peers.name: improve-animations
peers.description: Survey a codebase's animation and motion code as a senior motion advisor, then produce a prioritized audit and self-contained implementation plans for other agents (or cheaper models) to execute. Read-only on source code — it plans improvements, it does not apply them. Use when the user asks to "improve the animations", "audit the motion", "make this app feel better", or wants a roadmap of animation fixes rather than a review of a single diff.

en.tagline: Reviews animation code against a strict motion craft bar
en.summary: review-animations is a review-only skill for animation and motion code. It checks a diff against ten standards and flags problems such as ease-in on UI, animating layout properties, and missing reduced-motion handling. It ends with a Block or Approve decision.
problem: Animation code often ships without a check on whether it feels right. A transition can run correctly and still feel slow, start from the wrong origin, fire on every keypress, or drop frames.

With this skill, each animation in the diff is measured against the same ten standards. Each violation appears in a findings table with the current value, the suggested value, and the reason. The review ends with a verdict grouped by impact.
fit: Pull requests that add or change CSS transitions or keyframes
Motion library code that uses x, y, or scale props or layout animations
Popovers, dropdowns, tooltips, toasts, and accordions
unfit: General code review, which the skill declines and sends to a general review skill
Writing new animations or fixing bugs outside motion code, since the skill only reviews
steps: Invoke the skill with a question or a diff, since without a question it returns only a short ready message.
The skill reads STANDARDS.md, which holds the full rule catalog for easing, durations, springs, gestures, clip-path, performance, and accessibility.
Each animation in the diff is checked against the ten standards, and every violation is logged as a finding.
Fixes are ranked in a fixed order, starting with deleting the animation and ending with accessibility and cohesion.
The output is a findings table with Before, After, and Why columns, with each item cited by file and line.
The verdict groups the remaining issues by impact and ends with Block or Approve.

zh.tagline: 按严格的动效标准审查动画代码
zh.summary: review-animations 是一个只做审查的技能，用于检查动画和动效代码。它会按十条标准检查代码差异，标记诸如对 UI 使用 ease-in、为布局属性做动画、缺少减少动效处理等问题。最后给出 Block 或 Approve 的结论。
problem: 动画代码上线前，往往没有人检查它的手感是否正确。过渡效果可能能正常运行，但仍然偏慢、起点不对、每次按键都触发，或者掉帧。
使用这个技能后，代码差异中的每个动画都会按同一组十条标准衡量。每个违规项会以表格形式列出，包括当前值、建议值和原因。审查结论会按影响程度分组给出。
fit: 新增或修改 CSS 过渡与关键帧的拉取请求
使用 Motion 库的 x、y、scale 属性或布局动画的代码
弹出层、下拉菜单、工具提示、通知条和手风琴组件
unfit: 通用代码审查。该技能会拒绝这类请求，并建议改用通用审查技能
编写新动画，或修复动效代码之外的问题，因为该技能只做审查
steps: 带着问题或代码差异调用该技能；如果没有问题，它只会返回一句简短的就绪提示。
该技能读取 STANDARDS.md，其中包含缓动、时长、弹簧、手势、clip-path、性能和无障碍的完整规则目录。
代码差异中的每个动画都会按十条标准逐一检查，每个违规项都记为一条发现。
修复建议按固定顺序排列，从删除动画开始，到无障碍和风格统一结束。
输出是一张发现表，包含 Before、After 和 Why 三列，每项注明文件和行号。
结论会按影响程度对剩余问题分组，并以 Block 或 Approve 作结。
